content: उत्तप् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To warm, make hot, heat thoroughly, scorch, burn, sear; उत्तप्तनाराचलीलाम् <ls>Śi. 11. 50</ls>; उत्तपति सुवर्णं सुवर्णकारः <ls>Mbh.</ls> melts; so चैत्रो मैत्रस्य पाणिमुत्तपति. (Used in the <ab>Ā.</ab> when used intransitively ‘to shine’, or when it has a limb of the body for its object; उत्तपमानः आतपः <ls>Bk. 8. 15</ls> scorching heat; <ls>Śi. 20. 40</ls>; उत्तपते पाणी <ls>Mbh.</ls>). .²2 To pain, torment, torture by heat; कुसुमेषुरुत्तपति यद्विशिखैः <ls>Śi. 9. 67</ls>. .²3 To excite, urge on, press hard. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To warm, heat.
